item.title: Central Texas Food Bank & Austin ISD partner for school pantries
item.description: Earlier this year, the Central Texas Food Bank partnered with Austin Independent School District to establish six new Feeding Futures School Pantry locations.

item.title: President Trump honors Camp Mystic 'patriots' at National Prayer Breakfast
item.description: "Prayer is America’s superpower." At the 74th annual National Prayer Breakfast, President Trump honored the bravery of two Texas camp counselors who led children to safety during the 2025 flash floods.

item.title: VIDEO: Texas daycare worker caught on camera injuring child; family files suit
item.description: The boy's mother said the daycare claimed her son had been running around and hit his head after falling, says the family's attorneys. The boy also reportedly told his mom, “Ms. Jimenez hurt me."

item.title: Austin City Council passes TRUST Act to create framework for how city uses surveillance technology
item.description: The City of Austin will create a new framework for how to regulate surveillance technology. City Council unanimously voted for the TRUST Act. This comes as a controversial contract for park surveillance cameras was taken off the agenda for a second time.On Thursday, all the public commenters speaking on the TRUST Act were in favor of it.
